live_attempt.explanation: Render Free Tier instances automatically spin down to suspended state after 15 minutes of inactivity. In free tier deployments where monthly free active instance hours (750 hours/month) are exhausted or container cold wakeup hangs during container provisioning, Render holds incoming connections until client-side timeout. Live ping timed out after >75s on current execution.

render_region.dashboard_confirmation_status: Requires Render Web Dashboard Console Access
render_region.notes: Render Free Tier Web Services are provisioned in Oregon (us-west-1), Frankfurt (eu-central-1), Ohio (us-east-2), or Singapore. The repository environment configuration (evidences/06_live_health_ping.json) records the region as 'Singapore/Oregon'. Actual active instance region must be confirmed via the Region field in the Render dashboard service settings under Service Overview.
